data.claim: A delta review re-sends a CONFIRMED finding a later delta already cleared, whose fix diff is absent, so the reviewer reports it again as unfixed.
data.falsifier: The regression test test_a_confirmed_finding_cleared_by_a_delta_is_not_re_sent_in_a_later_delta fails on the unfixed code.
data.mechanism: context._with_previous_findings lists every prior chunk_finding with its triage for a delta; a confirmed-and-cleared finding (fixed before the delta's base) is not visible in the delta diff, so the reviewer cannot verify the fix and reports 'the named probe is not in this diff'.
data.probe_output: FAILED on unfixed code: assert 'bad line' not in second_delta (confirmed finding still re-sent); PASSED after the fix.
data.question: Why does a --delta review re-raise a confirmed finding whose fix predates the delta's base?

evidence.note: Claim: a --delta review re-sends a CONFIRMED finding a later delta already cleared, whose fix is absent from the delta diff, so the reviewer re-reports it (B2e1f4aedb5). Probe: regression test test_a_confirmed_finding_cleared_by_a_delta_is_not_re_sent_in_a_later_delta fails on unfixed code. Research note Rcb7fdf6a82 CONFIRMED.

Read the review re-review rules (r-*, D-gate-economy 3) and the delta/cleared-confirmed lessons (B64ed3cae18, B-push-failed-review-delta, B-review-gate-stuck-failed-after-triage); applied the confirmed-only cleared rule from failed_review.unresolved_review_failure.
ddflow/api/review/context.py: skip a confirmed finding a later delta already cleared from the delta re-review prompt; tests/test_gate_econ_rereview.py: regression test.

chunk_findings.detail: The fix only ever computes `cleared` for a current `kind == "delta"` prompt and relies on `_cleared_after_delta`, a delta-specific helper. A full re-review after a confirmed fix can also clear the finding, but that clear is not represented. Input: full round R0 raises finding F; author fixes F; a full re-review R1 is run and does not re-raise F; a subsequent commit is reviewed with `--delta`. Since R1 was full rather than delta, `_cleared_after_delta` does not recognize that F was already rechecked, so the stale confirmed F is sent again and can be reported as unfixed because the fix is before the later delta's base. This leaves the B2e1f4aedb5 failure in place for a supported re-review path.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/api/review/context.py:91

data.probe: the run shows a full re-review never strands a confirmed finding: a full round REPLACES the gate's findings, so a full re-review that does not re-raise a confirmed finding leaves chunk_findings empty (observed kind=full with 0 chunk_findings), and the subsequent --delta carries no finding text (observed re-send = False) -- there is no confirmed-cleared-by-full state to re-send. The delta-only predicate is ddflow's own unresolved_review_failure rule.
